prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 33 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1088; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the force involved is in keeping with a cervical and lumbar strain. Over the course of care the patient attended 33 visits, with near-daily attendance for much of that period. Several additional body regions were added to the treatment plan a number of weeks after the collision. Cervical and lumbar imaging was unremarkable, and orthopedic and neurological examinations were within normal limits. Nearly all of the reported findings rest on the patient's own description of pain and function. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar spine is documented in available records. Billing reviewed for this episode shows no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Recommendations include a graduated return to usual activities, a home exercise program, and reassessment of the treatment frequency at the next scheduled review.
